_llm_examples._note: Copy one of these blocks to 'llm' above. API keys go in GitHub Secrets, not here.

tests.name: Homepage loads
tests.instruction: Verify the page has a visible heading and the body contains meaningful text. Fail if it shows an error page or blank screen.

tests.name: Navigation links are valid
tests.instruction: Find all navigation links. Check they have valid href attributes and none are visually broken.

tests.name: Login form validates empty submission
tests.instruction: Find a login or sign-in form. Submit it without entering any data and verify a validation message appears.

tests.name: Search returns results
tests.instruction: Find the search input, type 'test', submit, and verify that results appear.

tests.name: No broken images
tests.instruction: Scan all img elements. Report any that failed to load (naturalWidth of 0 or missing src).

tests.name: Page is mobile responsive
tests.instruction: Check that the page layout does not overflow horizontally at 375px viewport width.
